question: What power manifests in the individual self upon cessation of limiting factors?
premises: Limiting factors such as time can cease.
The individual self possesses an inherent power of knowing and doing.
This power becomes pure when limitations are removed.
inference: Upon the cessation of limiting factors, the pure power of knowing and doing manifests by itself in the individual self.
plain_english: When those limiting factors cease, the pure power of knowing and doing arises by itself in the self.
